s: Which Indian State/UT has been chosen to host the G20 Summit in 2023?
x: India was a member of G-20 for a period of one year from December 1, 2022 to November 30, 2023. At the level of Heads of State/Government, The G-20 Leaders' Summit was held in New Delhi on September 9-10, 2023. The theme of G-20 Summit 2023 was ‘One Earth, One Family, One Future’. Significantly the 18th­ G20 Summit was held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil in November, 2024 under the theme Building a just World and a Sustainable Planet. The G20 Summit 2025 was held in South Africa. This historic event was the first time the summit took place on the African continent.

src: State PSC
s: Which country hosted the 2023 World Economic forum meeting?
x: The World Economic Forum (WEF) is an international advocacy non-governmental organization and think tank, based in Cologny, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. It was founded on 24 January 1971 by German engineer Klaus Schwab. The WEF is mostly known for its annual meeting at the end of January in Davos, a mountain resort in the canton of Graubünden, in the eastern Alps region of Switzerland. The 2023 annual meeting of the World Economic Forum took place in Davos, Switzerland, from 16-20 January, 2023 under the theme "Cooperation in a fragmented world". The 2026 World Economic Forum (WEF) Annual Meeting took place from 19-23 January, 2026, in Davos, Switzerland, under the theme "A Spirit of Dialogue".
